message.content:
Here are several free online tools and resources where you can get auto repair estimates:

## Major Free Online Auto Repair Estimate Tools

**RepairPal Fair Price Estimator**
One of the most widely recommended tools, RepairPal provides free instant car repair estimates based on your zip code. It guarantees fair prices for quality parts, labor times following industry guidelines, and labor rates aligned with average shops in your local area. You can see detailed breakdowns of parts costs and labor charges, plus helpful information about common symptoms, misdiagnoses, and expert advice.

**YourMechanic Estimates**
Offers free instant auto repair and maintenance estimates with complete price breakdowns showing parts and labor separately. You can also book a mobile mechanic to come to your home or office for service.

**Instant Estimator**
A completely free tool for cosmetic auto body and paint damage. It automatically assesses and costs your damage, lets you submit online photos for more precise quotes, and connects you to authorized auto body repair facilities in your area. You can get up to 3 free estimates from local shops.

**CarAid**
Provides repair estimates from photos you upload. They offer three delivery options: 60 minutes ($6.99), same day ($3.99), or free in 3-5 business days. Estimates include breakdowns for parts (OEM and aftermarket options), labor, paint, and miscellaneous fees.

## Free Auto Body/Collision Repair Estimates

**Caliber Collision Online Estimate**
Get free initial online estimates for auto body and collision repair, auto glass services, and car repair.

**Maaco Online Estimator**
Free online estimates for auto body repair, painting, and collision repair services.

**City of Stars Collision Center**
Free online auto body repair estimates with same-day response. Covers everything from paintless dent repair and auto glass to suspension repairs and auto painting.

## Other Free Resources

**FreeAutoMechanic.com**
Offers free auto repair estimates upon request using professional labor guide software. Covers US cars and trucks from 1990-2013. Response times may take up to a week due to high demand.

**Mechlance**
A mobile mechanic network offering free instant auto repair estimates. Mechanics come to you, and the platform claims you can save up to 50% on auto services.

**General Online Calculators**
Tools like the Auto Repair Costs Calculator at CertifiedCalculator.com and TagLab's Auto Repair Cost Calculator let you input labor rates, parts costs, and tax rates to calculate total repair costs.

## Tips for Using These Tools

- **Be specific** about your vehicle (year, make, model, VIN if possible) and the exact repair needed
- **Upload clear photos** of damage when possible for more accurate estimates
- **Get multiple estimates** to compare pricing
- **Remember these are estimates** - actual costs may vary after in-person inspection
- **Check if your insurance** will accept online estimates before filing claims
